fixture.name: cockpit-surfaces-disposable
prerequisites: Create uniquely named disposable Herdr session and isolated browser profile; never use default session, user profile, or unrelated tabs.
Provision two Spaces, two tabs in each Space where supported, multiple panes and agents, and two repositories/projects.
Repository A has changed tracked and untracked files plus context documents; Repository B has source imports and an empty directory.
Arrange one pending browser feedback item and delivery targets including one eligible and one ineligible target.
Record baseline commit, session/profile names, fixture IDs, viewport, and timestamps before interaction.
cleanup: Close all disposable tabs and panes, stop disposable agents, delete temporary repositories/files, remove feedback and delivery fixtures, close isolated browser profile, then destroy disposable Herdr session.
Retain screenshots, machine logs, action trace, and failure diagnostics; do not clean retained evidence.

requiredPerCell: action trace with keyboard/mouse modality and timestamp
screenshot at 1440x900 and 1024x640 after stable state (or explicit unavailable reason)
machine evidence: URL/route, session and Space IDs, active tab/pane/agent IDs, DOM/accessibility snapshot, console/network errors, and relevant API response or persisted state
expected visible state, empty/loading/error/recovery observations, and annotation/paste presentation where applicable
result is PASS only when all observable proof is retained; INCONCLUSIVE requires named attempts and diagnostics
evidenceContract.retry: Retry once with same input after waiting for idle; retry a second time after reopening the affected menu/view. If still failing, capture screenshot, DOM/state, console/network trace, and exact action trace; classify INCONCLUSIVE and escalate with IDs.
evidenceContract.annotation: Annotations must be rendered in the actual surface with stable numbered callouts, preserve source line/file identity, visibly distinguish added/removed/context ranges, and retain a mapping from callout to machine evidence. Capture unannotated and annotated views when annotation is present.

prerequisites: Fixture active with an agent and focused workspace

cells.action: Press the documented command-menu shortcut, then type a known command prefix
cells.expected: Menu opens, focus is in search, matching commands and enabled/disabled state are visible
cells.proof: Both viewport screenshots show focus ring, query, result count and command labels; machine evidence records active element and command registry.
cells.recovery: Escape closes menu and restores prior focus; retry with pointer after reload.

cells.action: Click command/menu affordance and select a command with pointer
cells.expected: Menu opens at affordance, pointer selection highlights then executes exactly once
cells.proof: Screenshots show anchor, hover/selected row and resulting surface; machine trace records click coordinates and command event/result.
cells.recovery: Dismiss and reopen; on execution error retain error banner and retry action evidence.

cells.action: Use ArrowUp/ArrowDown, Enter, and Escape; submit a command that changes active view
cells.expected: Roving selection is visible, Enter executes selected command, Escape cancels without mutation
cells.proof: Screenshots capture selection before submit and resulting view; state/API evidence proves one mutation or no mutation after cancel.
cells.recovery: Reopen menu and repeat once; restore original view during cleanup.

prerequisites: Two Spaces and two tabs each provisioned
At least two panes and agents visible

cells.action: Open Space switcher, move between Spaces with keyboard, select second Space
cells.expected: Second Space becomes active with its tab/pane context preserved
cells.proof: Screenshots at both sizes show Space identity, active tab and pane; machine evidence records Space/tab/pane IDs before and after.
cells.recovery: Return to first Space with shortcut; reopen switcher after reload if transition fails.

cells.action: Click Space menu, choose a Space, open its tab menu and select each tab
cells.expected: Menus close after selection and selected tab is visibly active
cells.proof: Capture menu open, selected tab, and overflow/empty state; record click coordinates, active IDs, and tab list response.
cells.recovery: Reopen menu and select by keyboard; do not close fixture tabs unless cleanup.

cells.action: Cycle panes/agents by keyboard and click a pane header
cells.expected: Only one pane/agent has focus; content and status correspond to focused ID
cells.proof: Screenshots show focus indicator and agent status; accessibility snapshot and event trace prove focus transition.
cells.recovery: Retry after idle, then restart only disposable agent and capture lifecycle diagnostics.

prerequisites: Repository A changed tracked/untracked files; Repository B empty directory
Files route available in active project

cells.action: Open Files, expand repository tree, select changed tracked file and untracked file
cells.expected: Tree expansion and selected file are visible; file content and changed status render
cells.proof: Both screenshots show breadcrumb, tree/status badges and selected content; machine evidence includes file IDs, route, and filesystem/API response.
cells.recovery: Refresh tree, reopen repository, then retry selection; retain error payload if unresolved.

cells.action: Focus file search, type exact and partial names, navigate results and clear query
cells.expected: Results filter deterministically, selection remains accessible, clearing restores tree
cells.proof: Screenshots capture query, no-match/loading/error and restored tree; record key events, result IDs and latency/error.
cells.recovery: Escape clears search; reopen Files after reload and repeat once.

cells.action: Open changed file diff and toggle annotation rendering; select a line/callout
cells.expected: Added/removed/context ranges and stable numbered callouts are readable and map to source lines
cells.proof: Capture unannotated and annotated diff at both sizes; machine evidence maps callout numbers to file/line/range and records toggle state.
cells.recovery: Toggle off/on, reopen diff, and retain raw diff plus rendering diagnostics.

prerequisites: Context documents and imported source fixtures present
Repository B includes an empty directory

cells.action: Open Context browser, navigate document hierarchy, expand and select a context document
cells.expected: Hierarchy, selected document metadata, and content are visible
cells.proof: Screenshots show hierarchy and content at both sizes; DOM/accessibility and context IDs/content hash are retained.
cells.recovery: Collapse/reopen node, then reload route and retry once.

cells.action: Open source-import view, inspect imported source and provenance, follow source link
cells.expected: Imported source renders with repository/path provenance and link opens correct project
cells.proof: Capture provenance and destination route; machine evidence records import job/status, source hash, and navigation event.
cells.recovery: Retry import once after idle; preserve job logs and classify unresolved failure.

cells.action: Search context/source, use Arrow keys and Enter, then clear query
cells.expected: Matches are announced/highlighted and selected result opens without losing Space context
cells.proof: Screenshots show query/match/empty/error states; accessibility snapshot records announcements and IDs before/after.
cells.recovery: Escape/clear and reopen browser; retry with exact title.

prerequisites: Disposable setup route and two repositories available
Changed files and source imports ready

cells.action: Open setup, choose Repository A, configure project, submit, and observe workspace transition
cells.expected: Validation is visible, submit creates/opens intended project and preserves provenance
cells.proof: Capture form, validation/loading/error, and resulting workspace at both sizes; record request payload/result and project ID.
cells.recovery: Correct invalid field and resubmit; on failure reopen setup and retain response/logs.

cells.action: Open Sources, inspect imported source, add/refresh a source, then remove only disposable source
cells.expected: Source status/provenance updates and confirmation protects removal
cells.proof: Screenshots show each state and confirmation; machine evidence records source IDs, status transitions, and no mutation after cancel.
cells.recovery: Retry refresh once; restore source fixture during cleanup.

cells.action: Open Review, inspect changes, navigate annotations, select eligible delivery target, attempt ineligible target, submit eligible delivery
cells.expected: Review groups changes, annotations map to source, eligible target can submit, ineligible target is blocked with reason
cells.proof: Capture review and annotated/unannotated states at both sizes; record change IDs, target eligibility, validation response, and delivery receipt.
cells.recovery: Retry failed submission once without duplicate delivery; retain idempotency/result evidence.

prerequisites: Isolated browser profile paired to disposable session
One pending feedback item and one resolved/empty condition

cells.action: Open browser feedback overview, inspect pending item, filter by status, open detail
cells.expected: Pending feedback count, filters, detail, and source URL are visible
cells.proof: Screenshots at both sizes show count/filter/detail and connection state; machine evidence records extension/session IDs, feedback ID, URL, and events.
cells.recovery: Reconnect isolated extension and reopen overview; never touch unrelated tabs.

cells.action: Acknowledge/resolve pending feedback, cancel a second action, then verify overview count
cells.expected: Confirmed resolution updates count; cancelled action leaves item pending
cells.proof: Capture before/after and cancellation; record confirmation, API result, and persisted status.
cells.recovery: Retry once after refresh; preserve stale/conflict response and diagnostics.

prerequisites: Review contains changed source with line ranges and pending feedback
Eligible and ineligible delivery targets configured

cells.action: Render annotations in Files and Review, hover/focus callouts, toggle visibility, inspect long and empty ranges
cells.expected: Callouts remain numbered/stable, line mapping and added/removed/context styling are legible at both viewports
cells.proof: Capture unannotated plus annotated screenshots at both sizes, including hover/focus and overflow; machine evidence maps each callout to source identity/range and renderer diagnostics.
cells.recovery: Toggle off/on and reopen view; if collision persists capture layout bounds and classify INCONCLUSIVE.

cells.action: Choose eligible target, open paste/delivery preview, copy/paste rendered annotated content, then cancel preview
cells.expected: Preview matches source and annotations, clipboard/paste preserves required mapping, cancel causes no delivery
cells.proof: Capture preview, clipboard/paste result, and cancelled state at both sizes; machine evidence records target eligibility, payload hash, clipboard permission/error, and no-submit receipt.
cells.recovery: Retry with keyboard-only copy/paste after permission prompt; retain clipboard/error diagnostics.

cells.action: Submit eligible delivery, wait for receipt, then verify ineligible target remains blocked
cells.expected: Exactly one successful receipt with target and payload identity; blocked target explains requirement
cells.proof: Screenshots capture submit/progress/success/block/error at both sizes; machine evidence includes idempotency key, request/response, receipt, target eligibility and final state.
cells.recovery: Retry once only with same idempotency key; never duplicate delivery. Escalate unresolved state with full retained diagnostics.
